summary: The patch correctly rejects explicit null content when a Cerebras choice has no tool call or refusal, and adds a focused budget-stopped reasoning-only regression test.

evidence: src/provider/cerebras.ts now treats both undefined and null content as no payload when no tool calls or refusal exist.
tests/openai-compat-part11.test.ts adds a focused case with content: null and finish_reason: length, asserting HTTP 502 and cerebras_upstream_invalid_response.
